title: nWo Hollywood vs. the Wolfpac
summary: Hogan and Nash’s conflict divides the nWo into competing camps. Hall’s choice and Sting’s eventual allegiance make the split a struggle over both friendships and faction power.

chapters.title: Nash establishes the Wolfpac
chapters.result: Nash’s red-and-black group breaks from Hogan’s nWo.
chapters.context: Savage and Konnan join the new faction as the former alliance becomes a civil war.

chapters.title: Hall chooses Hogan’s side
chapters.result: Hall turns on Nash, costing the Outsiders their tag titles.
chapters.context: The split reaches the friendship at the center of the nWo’s original arrival.

chapters.title: Sting joins the red and black
chapters.context: WCW’s most prominent nWo opponent now chooses Nash’s faction against Hogan’s branch.
